summary: A polished riverside hotel jazz bar for cocktails and live music in the Mandarin Oriental, with a smart dress code and no reservations.
whyGo: A distinctive Bangkok night out built around live jazz and blues in a long-running, intimate hotel bar.
The current drinks list includes Thai spirits and cocktails using local ingredients.
bestFor: Visitors already exploring the Chao Phraya riverside
skipIf: You want an inexpensive night out
You need a guaranteed table or have a large group
You cannot meet the evening dress code
duration: Allow 1–2 hours for drinks and a music set; arrive with time to find a seat, as the bar does not take reservations.
cost: Premium pricing: the current official menu lists many spirits around THB 420–700, before 10% service charge and 7% VAT. Budget roughly THB 600–900 per cocktail after charges; check the live menu for current prices.
hours: Official listing: 5pm–1am Sunday–Thursday and 5pm–2am Friday–Saturday. Live band with vocalist Monday–Thursday 8pm–11:45pm and Friday–Saturday 8pm–12:45am; Sunday pianist 9pm–11:45pm. Verify closer to travel.
bestTime: Go shortly after opening for a better chance of seating; for the full music experience, attend during the posted evening set. Weekends may be busier.
gettingThere: At Mandarin Oriental, 48 Oriental Avenue, Bang Rak, on the Chao Phraya river. The hotel operates shuttle boats to Saphan Taksin BTS and ICONSIAM; take the boat from the BTS pier to the hotel, or use a taxi/ride-hail to the hotel entrance. Confirm boat operations and timings with the hotel on the day.
booking: Walk-in only; the official bar page says reservations are not accepted. For enquiries call +66 2 659 9000 or email mobkk-bamboobar@mohg.com. Arrive early if seating matters.
accessibility: The venue is inside a hotel, but current official information does not specify step-free access, accessible toilets, or seating arrangements. Contact the hotel in advance to confirm the route and any access needs.
practicalTips: After 6:30pm, wear elegant attire and proper footwear; men need long trousers and closed shoes. Sleeveless shirts for men are not allowed at any time.
Guests under 20 may enter only before 7:30pm; later they may accompany an adult on the outdoor terrace, subject to availability.
Check the live menu and music schedule before setting a budget or planning around a particular performer.
decemberNotes: December 2026 falls in the busy year-end travel period. The bar's published regular hours and music schedule are available, but no specific December 2026 holiday schedule or special event was confirmed; check directly before going, especially around Christmas and New Year's Eve.
uncertainties: Hours, music, prices and entry policy may change before December 2026; the official menu itself notes service charge and VAT, and the current total depends on the order.
No public accessibility details were found; contact the hotel to confirm step-free access and facilities.
